Dialogs.Dialog: Anegasaki
Hey, wake up.
Mm... just a little longer...
You're going to be late, you know？
Like I said, a little longer...
Geez... your girlfriend's waking you up, and you're going to keep sleeping？
Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!? Wh-why are you in my room!?
Geez, I told you, didn't I？ That I'd come wake you up.
Did you？ Whoa, did you see me in my pajamas？
What are you saying at this point？ Come on, if you don't hurry and get ready, I'll leave without you, sleepyhead.
...Yes, ma'am.
Geez, you really are such a kid...
Anegasaki
Hey, wake up.
Mmm... let me sleep a little more...
Please wake up. De-ar.
No... I have a girlfriend named ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
...Geez, hey.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!? You came to wake me up.
Yep. Even for a certain someone who cheats in his dreams, I keep my promises, you know？
A dream？ ...I forgot, hahaha.
I'll hear your excuses verrry thoroughly later.
Ahaha...
Anegasaki
Hey, I think you'd better get up now.
Hmm... Three more minutes...
You'll be late for school, you know？ Hey, get up.
Just a little longer...
No～. Get. Up.
Like I said, a little longer... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!?
I promised to come wake you up in the morning, remember？ Did you forget？
Sorry. Did you...
Come on, get out of the futon... eek！
What？
Geez, put your clothes on properly？ You're a mess, you know？
Sorry.
(She saw me in an embarrassing state...)
Anegasaki
Hey, wake up.
Mmm... a little longer...
Geez, hurry and get up？
...Huh？ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Good morning.
Yes, good morning. Somehow... it's like we're married...
Anegasaki
Hey, it's time to get up.
Hmm～ Hmm...
Geez... if you don't get up, I'm going to play a prank on you？
...Hm？ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... morning. *Yawn*.
Good morning. Hehe, hurry and get ready？ Or no breakfast for you？
Anegasaki
Good morning！ Hey, wake up.
Hmm...
Hmm... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, good morning.
Hehe, you've got bedhead.
Huh!?
Geez, oh well. You're hopeless without me, huh？
Anegasaki
Hey. I'd be happy if you were hungry right now...
It's lunch break, so I am, but why？
Well... hehe. I made a lunch today.
Could it be... for me？
My girlfriend's homemade lunch... I'm so moved.
Geez... it's nothing that fancy, okay？
Ooh, looks tasty. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ really is domestic.
Try it. And... tell me if the seasoning is okay... maybe？
Yeah. The flavor's perfect too. I like light seasoning like this.
Good... I'll make it again, so tell me what you think.
Anegasaki
Hello.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. What's up？
Hehe, actually, I made a lunch box today.
A lunch？ Can I have it？
On the condition that you eat every bite. Okay？
Ah, a Japanese-style lunch？ Nice, it really feels homemade.
It ended up that way since I picked healthy things. Do you not like this kind of thing？
No way. ...Yeah, it tastes good too. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is good at cooking too, huh.
Hehe. Cooking's pretty fun once you try it, you know？ Shall I make it again？
Yeah. Please.
Hehe. ...Ah, look, you have to chew properly... there's tea too, so slowly, okay？
Anegasaki
Ah, there you are.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ What's up？
Hehe. You see, a lunch.
A lunch？ Did you make it for me？
Yes. We're dating, so I should do at least this much. Hehehe.
Ah, a Japanese-style lunch？
I like Japanese food. It's a bit plain, but it's healthy, you know. Here, try it.
Plain... yeah, it's good. Just what I'd expect from ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Hehe. Maybe I'll go to cooking classes while I'm at it.
You don't need to go to anything like that, it's plenty good.
Really？ I'm glad. Then maybe I'll make it again.
Anegasaki
Here you are.
Thanks.
Today's is a Japanese-style lunch.
Yay！ I love this. Thanks for the food.
Eat lots, okay？
Anegasaki
Here you are.
Thanks. Oh, Japanese style today.
Hehe. Thinking about my boyfriend's health, Japanese food is best, right？
Yeah. Thanks for the food.
Geez, no one's going to take it, so eat slowly. Okay？
Anegasaki
Here you are.
Thanks. Lately, I've been looking forward to this.
Hehe. You say such sweet things... today it comes with miso soup, you know？
Ooh, smells good. Time to dig in.
Ah, hey, don't eat in a rush. You'll burn yourself.
Anegasaki
Hey, come over here a sec.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. What's up？
You see, I made you a lunch today.
For me!? I'm so happy, is it okay？
I hope you like it...
Whoa, it's so fancy. The presentation's stylish too...
How about the taste？
Thanks for the food... mm, this is really good. Perfect！
Hehehe. I figured boys like rich stuff like this.
Yeah, it's good. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ really is good at cooking too.
Then shall I make it again？ If you have any requests for side dishes, tell me.
Anegasaki
Hello. Got a minute？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, what's up？
Don't you know？ It's lunch break now, right？
Then, want to eat together？
Hehe. I figured, so I made lunch... what do you say？
Really!?
Here you go. I went with a Western-style lunch... do you like this kind？
Yeah, I love it, love it. Thanks！ Thanks for the food.
How is it？ Good？
Yeah, super good！ ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is a great cook.
I actually like it, believe it or not. But I feel like I still need to practice more, I guess？
It's plenty tasty already, though.
If you praise me that much, I might start feeding you up like a pet, you know？ Hehe.
Anegasaki
Ah, I knew you'd be here. Hehe, way too predictable.
Huh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ What's up, at lunch break？
Hehe, quiz time. I made a lunch. Will you eat it with me, or won't you？ Which is it？
Really!? I'll eat it, I'll eat it.
Hehe. Then here you are.
A Western-style lunch？ Nice. I love this kind of thing.
I knew it. How's the seasoning？ Will you tell me what you think？
Thanks for the food. Yeah, the flavor's perfect！ It's good, what's in it？
All sorts of things, but the main ingredient is love, I guess.
Eh!?
Hehe. Shall I bring it again？ Is there anything you don't like？
Anegasaki
Here you are.
Oh, thanks. Looks tasty again today...
I tried something a little different... how is it？
Yeah, it's good. This one especially, isn't it pro level？
I don't know about that. ...But I'm glad. Eat slowly, okay？
Anegasaki
Here you are.
Thanks. Ah, Western. Huh... it looks like a lunch sold at a store.
Hehe. Maybe it's only looks？
No way. ...Yeah, it's delicious after all！
Hehe, if you say it too many times, it starts to sound like flattery. Ah, there's something on your cheek, geez.
Anegasaki
Here, today's lunch is a Western-style lunch I put my all into.
You made all of this, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Hehe. A healthy menu, low in salt and calories. Impressed？
Impressed doesn't even cover it, this is really amazing...
Hehe. Want me to feed you, "say ahh"？
Anegasaki
Ah... hey, hey.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ What's up？
W-well... I had a little extra time this morning... so, a lunch.
You went to the trouble, for me？
Yes... was it unnecessary？
Not at all, I'm really happy.
It's Chinese, is that okay？ If you don't like it, I'll have to say sorry for today...
Totally fine. More importantly... this is amazing, it looks store-bought.
How's the taste？ I worked hard on the seasoning too.
Then, thanks for the food... mm, delicious！ It's really good.
I'm glad... then, maybe I'll keep making them？
Anegasaki
Hello. How are you doing？
Huh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ What's up, at lunch break？
Actually, I made you a lunch.
Huh, really？ Yay, I saved on lunch money～.
...If you're going to say that, I won't give it to you.
Wait. Sorry, forgive me.
Geez, it'd be a waste otherwise, so I'll forgive you.
Here, the Chinese special.
I love it, love it. Hearty stuff like this is great.
How's the taste？ Ah, you can be honest. I won't get mad.
No, really, it's delicious！ Amazing. You could open a restaurant, it'd be a guaranteed hit！
Geez, when you go that far, it sounds fake, right？ ...But I'm glad you liked it.
Anegasaki
Ah, there you are. You haven't eaten lunch yet, right？
Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ I was just about to go buy lunch...？
Hehe. Actually, I made a lunch.
A homemade lunch from ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ Really？
Yes, let's eat together.
Whoa, a Chinese lunch. So hearty！ Thanks for the food.
How's the taste？ I worked hard on it, is it good？
Good... too good... it's almost a waste to eat it.
You say such sweet things. I'll get carried away and make it again, you know？
Anegasaki
Here you are.
Oh, thanks.
You liked Chinese food, right？
Yeah. Thanks for the food.
Yes, please enjoy. Hehe.
Anegasaki
Here, Chinese today. I kept it warm so it wouldn't get cold.
Thanks. Time to dig in... ow, hot！
Geez, right after I said that. Can't you eat a little more calmly？
Well, it's really delicious.
If you put it that way, I give up. Eat however you like. Ah, there's soup too.
Anegasaki
Here, your lunch. Today it's a Chinese lunch packed with energy.
Thanks for the food. Mm, delicious！
Hehe. Is that good？ Then, want to try mine too？
But then there won't be any left for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
I made too much... so today, as a special service, I'll feed you. Open up, say ahh？
